item.title: New “Songs” section: a cross-referenced matrix of every song against every show — see eac…
item.description: New “Songs” section: a cross-referenced matrix of every song against every show — see each time a song was played across Jerry, the Mad Hannans, and Sean, browse it as a filterable list or a songs-by-shows grid, and search for any song by name. Every performance has its own player and a link to that show.
